## Expected Behavior
No more CVEs found

## Actual Behavior

Closing this issue as the Go dependency CVEs are false positives, and base image updates are tracked separately.

## Analysis

### Go Dependency CVEs - False Positives

The scanner is reporting incorrect versions. The actual v1.29.x dependencies already include the fixes:

| CVE | Package | Scanner Reports | Actual v1.29.x | Status |
|-----|---------|-----------------|----------------|--------|
| CVE-2025-22870 | golang.org/x/net | v0.34.0 | v0.39.0 | ✅ Fixed (requires v0.36.0+) |
| CVE-2023-47108 | otelgrpc | v0.36.4 | v0.59.0 | ✅ Fixed (requires v0.46.0+) |
| CVE-2024-44337 | gomarkdown | reported | N/A | ✅ Not a dependency |
| CVE-2024-2689 | go.temporal.io/server | v1.18.1-... | v1.29.x | ✅ Fixed in v1.20.5 |

The `v1.18.1-0.20230217005328-b313b7f58641` version string the scanner found doesn't reflect the actual server version - this appears to be a scanner artifact.

### Base Image CVEs (curl/openssl)

These are valid findings from the Alpine base image. Base image updates are handled through our Docker image build process and will be picked up in subsequent releases.

### Recommendation

**v1.29.2 is now available** (released 2025-12-30) with additional security fixes. Please upgrade to the latest patch version.
